newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey says troops kill 35 rebel Kurds in Iraq.
newsitem.headline: Turkey says troops kill 35 rebel Kurds in Iraq.

text.p: Turkish Foreign Minister Tansu Ciller said security forces had killed 35 rebel Kurds in an attack across the border in northern Iraq on Friday, the state-run Anatolian news agency reported.
"In an operation in northern Iraq today a cave was attacked. (Troops) captured 35 PKK (Kurdistan Workers Party) members dead and 45 alive," Ciller said. She gave no further details.
There was no independent confirmation of the deaths.
Turkey often mounts cross-border offensives into northern Iraq, which the PKK uses as a base for attacks into southeast Turkey.
